## How it works

<h2>Developer integration</h2><p>The page queries walls and their containing storeys through <code>viewer.IfcAPI</code>, then builds a wall-installation activity for each returned storey. Labels, membership and counts come from the loaded model. The click handler builds a selection-only BCF update, writes it with <code>bcf.save()</code>, then applies it with <code>viewer.add()</code> and <code>viewer.selectTopic()</code>. One topic is reused; no camera, colors or visibility filters are supplied.</p><p>Copy this folder and serve it over HTTP, for example <code>python -m http.server 8080</code>. Open <code>http://localhost:8080/</code>; the SDK and sample downloads require internet access.</p>
<p>The page opens the original source bytes with <code>await viewer.IfcAPI</code>, reads native model data, then closes the model and disposes WASM before displaying the source with <code>viewer.add()</code>. See the <a href="https://thatopen.github.io/engine_web-ifc/docs/classes/web-ifc.IfcAPI.html">complete web-ifc API reference</a>.</p>
